description: This is a setup script for the OpenERP (Odoo) server, handling installation, module dependencies, data files, and build configurations.

classes.name: openerp_server_install
classes.description: Custom install class for setting up the OpenERP server startup script

methods.name: check_modules
methods.description: Checks for required Python modules and exits if any are missing

methods.name: find_addons
methods.description: Generator that yields addon module names found in the 'bin/addons' directory

methods.name: data_files
methods.description: Builds a list of data files to be installed based on platform and available files
